title: Ultimate Remote
summary: Universal remote control for the Cardputer Zero
description:
A powerful universal remote control supporting 3366 remote profiles from 636 different manufacturers and containing around 30,000 commands. It allows you to easily find a suitable remote for you device thanks to a automatic remotes scan. Now, with added compatibility for .ir files of the Flipper-IRDB.

Ultimate Remote gives you access to virtually every IR remote control code available online by combining two of the largest infrared code databases.
